name: Angaekkoch Jil Mulyeob
source:
Raindrops fall, petals fall. 
In the midst of a rainy history,
And I ran into him on an endless cycle of reincarnation. 
Raindrops fall, petals fall.
In the midst of a rainy story,
And on an endless cycle of reincarnation.
[Translated from [url=https://m.onestore.co.kr/mobilepoc/apps/appsDetail.omp?prodId=0000723320]onestore[/url]]
translation:
雨滴落下，花瓣落下。
在一段风雨历程中，
而我却在无尽的轮回中遇见了他。
雨滴落下，花瓣落下。
在一场雨的故事中，
并在无尽的轮回中。
